input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?label ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zlabel .
  FILTER(?zlabel IN ("Perimeter_mid_ZN_3", "DataCenter_top_ZN_6"))
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a brick:Occupancy_Sensor .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?ext .
  ?ext ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}
